Quick notes from the SKU & ops side after scanning the form and MSA redlines:

1) SKU mapping: CloudWave's offering is subscription-based (monthly/annual) with an optional metered addon for enterprise tokens. On GCP we typically map subscription SKUs as a single listing SKU + metered usage SKU for add-ons. That keeps the procurement flow straightforward (one line item for renewals).

2) Pricing cap/quotas: If they want tiered pricing, we'll need the expected ARR by tier so we can propose a public SKU pricing structure. If they don't want public pricing, we can support private pricing via reseller/contract.

3) Billing fields required for procurement intake (Karthik, please confirm):
   - Legal entity name
   - Billing address + tax ID (W-9 / VAT)
   - Preferred invoice recipient email and PO number format
   - Billing contact name and phone

4) Timeline: assuming completed seller invite + signed MSA, typical time-to-live for a listing is ~2-3 weeks (legal review, SKU creation, marketplace validation). If we need co-sell enablement and listing launch QA, add an extra 1 week.

Action items: Marcus to draft SKU map template (I'll attach after this thread), Karthik to open intake ticket after we get billing fields, Vanessa to schedule the partner kickoff and own co-sell plan.

—Marcus
